meta.title: Racehub Driver's Academy
meta.description: Structured karting training in Vietnam — racecraft, coaching, and a real pathway from first laps to competitive racing.

why.label: Why Join
why.usp1Desc: Every session follows a clear plan focused on improvement, not just track time.
why.usp2Desc: We teach positioning, decision-making, and race awareness — not just speed.
why.usp3Desc: Drivers build skills step by step through regular, focused training.
why.usp4Desc: Limited drivers per session to ensure proper coaching and individual feedback.
why.usp5Desc: Every run is reviewed. Drivers understand what to fix and how to improve.
why.usp6Desc: Opportunities to progress into regional racing, including the ROK series.

programs.label: Programs
programs.cadetDesc: Sunday program for cadet drivers. 2 track weekends at Dai Nam with Coach Steven, assisted by Peter, and 2 simulator weekends at Cheat Code Cafe, BLOQ with Coach Blayke Philips or Coach Steven.
programs.cadetLi2: Dai Nam training from 8:00 AM–12:00 PM
programs.cadetLi3: 2 drivers on track at a time
programs.cadetLi4: Track heats, feedback, and video review
programs.cadetLi5: Simulator training with Blayke or Steven
programs.juniorDesc: Sunday program for junior drivers. 2 track weekends at Dai Nam with Coach Steven, assisted by Peter, and 2 simulator weekends at Cheat Code Cafe, BLOQ with Coach Blayke Philips or Coach Steven.
programs.juniorLi2: Dai Nam training from 8:00 AM–12:00 PM
programs.juniorLi3: 2 drivers on track at a time
programs.juniorLi5: Simulator training with Blayke or Steven

pathway.label: Racing Pathway
pathway.item1: Train and compete at regional circuits such as Bira and Sepang
pathway.item3: Receive race coaching, preparation, and trackside support

karts.label: Equipment
karts.sub: We train on proper race karts, not rental karts. Race-level performance, consistency, and control.
karts.title: CS55 Racing
karts.desc: Full-performance race kart for adult drivers training at competitive levels.

team.label: Coaching Team
team.sub: Coaches who focus on racecraft, discipline, and preparing drivers for competitive racing.
team.davidBio: David Guibal is a professional karting coach and the original Founder of Infinity Racing in Vietnam. Coming from a racing family, with his father involved in Citroën Racing during the Sébastien Loeb era, David brings deep motorsport experience from competing across Asia in the Senior Rotax Series. He helps drivers develop racecraft, kart control, setup understanding, and competitive confidence from beginner to advanced levels.
team.blaykeBio: Blayke Philips is a simulator coach specializing in remote driver development and race preparation. He helps drivers improve consistency, decision-making, racing lines, braking technique, and race scenarios through structured simulator training. His coaching supports on-track progress by helping drivers build confidence, discipline, and sharper racecraft between track sessions.
team.stevenBio: Nguyen Trung Quan (Steven Nguyen) is a professional motorsport instructor and Co-Founder of Speed Master Club. He has trained multiple Pro Kart programs, helping drivers develop racing technique, vehicle control, safety awareness, and confidence from beginner to advanced levels.

approach.label: Training Approach
approach.step1Desc: Track overview and clear objectives for the session.
approach.step2Desc: Controlled runs with focused drills — lines, braking, exits.
approach.step3Desc: Video and data breakdown with individual feedback.
approach.step4Desc: Apply corrections immediately and build consistency.
approach.quote: "Drivers don't improve by turning more laps — they improve by understanding them."

gear.label: Required Gear
gear.sub: Proper gear is mandatory. Safety is non-negotiable.
gear.note: We can assist with selecting the right gear through Racehub, or provide rental gear for single-day training sessions.

form.label: Apply
form.sub: Tell us a bit about the driver, and we'll get in touch to discuss the next steps.
form.goalsLabel: What are you looking to achieve?
